content.value_statement: Paid ad teams need many variants that still match the landing page. This skill creates platform-ready copy, angle matrices, and claim checks.
actual_capabilities: Generates up to 15 Google RSA headlines and 4 descriptions.
Builds angle matrices with distinct benefits, pains, proof points, and objections.
Maps each ad unit to a destination page claim.
Applies local format specs for Google, Meta, and short-form hooks.
Flags unsupported claims, guarantees, policy risks, and missing sources.
Prepares a handoff summary for saved creative work after confirmation.
limitations: Requires an offer, platform, audience, and destination page source.
Does not score ad account performance or spend efficiency.
Does not optimize landing pages after the ad click.
Platform limits can change, so final exports need platform UI verification.

use_cases.title: Launch Search Ads
use_cases.description: Create RSA headlines and descriptions that match a product page and stay within format limits.

use_cases.title: Explore Creative Angles
use_cases.description: Turn one offer into benefit, pain, proof, urgency, objection, and category framing options.

use_cases.title: Refresh Losing Variants
use_cases.description: Replace weak headlines while preserving proven themes and approved claim wording.

prompt_templates.title: Generate RSA Drafts
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate 15 Google RSA headlines and 4 descriptions for [offer]. Use [landing page URL] as the message-match source.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a new offer.

prompt_templates.title: Build Angle Matrix
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a 3 by 3 angle matrix for [offer] on [platform]. Include hooks, audience intent, and matching page claims.

prompt_templates.title: Iterate Losing Variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Revise these low-performing headlines: [paste headlines]. Keep winning themes, replace weak ideas, and map each result to [landing page URL].

prompt_templates.title: Create Full Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a full creative set for [offer] on [platform]. Include RSA assets, social hooks, message-match notes, claim risks, and a handoff summary.

output_examples.input: Need Google RSA copy for a B2B onboarding tool with a product page.
output_examples.output: The skill returns 15 headlines, 4 descriptions, display path ideas, and notes linking each line to page claims.

output_examples.input: Need fresh angles for a Meta campaign.
output_examples.output: The skill returns benefit, pain, proof, and objection angles with hook ideas and format-aware copy suggestions.
The skill keeps strong themes, replaces weak variants, and flags claims that need source evidence.

best_practices: Provide the landing page URL or pasted page copy before requesting copy.
Include approved claim wording when regulated or proof-heavy claims matter.
Verify character limits in the ad platform before uploading final assets.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to invent statistics, testimonials, prices, or guarantees.
Do not use it to score account performance or budget efficiency.
Do not copy competitor ads from transparency libraries.

faq.question: Which ad formats does it support?
faq.answer: It covers Google RSA, Performance Max text assets, Meta feed copy, and short-form hook lines.

faq.question: Does it need API access?
faq.answer: No. It works with user-provided exports, URLs, and pasted copy. APIs are optional conveniences.

faq.question: Can it use a destination URL?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses a URL or pasted page copy as the message-match source when available.

faq.question: Does it replace legal review?
faq.answer: No. It flags claim and policy risks, but final legal approval remains with the user.

faq.question: Can it save results?
faq.answer: Yes. It can save a handoff summary after the user confirms the save action.

faq.question: How does it handle competitor ads?
faq.answer: It can study public ad-library examples for angles, but it should not copy creative.
